items.title: Skift Global Forum East: Five Decisions in the Room
items.excerpt: The most ambitious growth story in global tourism is being tested on every front as multiple wars fester throughout the Middle East. Every decision travel executives make today has to consider the long-term impact when these conflicts resolve.

items.title: Without a COP31 Deal, Destinations Have a Weaker Signal for Climate Resilience
items.excerpt: A failed decision at COP31 doesn’t stop tourism being able to take action on the ground. Without a guiding goal, destinations risk losing a long-term investment signal and political backstop for climate resilience and adaptation.

items.title: Hyatt Is ‘Sharpening’ Its Brands So AI Can Tell Them Apart
items.excerpt: Hyatt is drawing sharper distinctions among brands such as Andaz and Thompson. Getting hotels to deliver on those promises is the harder task.

items.title: Why Big Investors Are Buying Europe’s Holiday Parks
items.excerpt: The world's biggest investors are discovering Europe's holiday parks, where valuable properties don't always mean profitable businesses.

items.title: AirAsia’s Q3 Shows Why Fernandes Pushed the Comeback to 2028
items.excerpt: AirAsia has shown it can charge more. It hasn't shown it can make money at its new, smaller size. Until the $1 billion debt financing lands, the balance sheet, not demand, decides when the comeback starts.
